desc: Derivation: Pr[i anc x]=1/i (i<x), joint ancestor prob 2/(i(i+1)) for i<u<v, 1/u for i=u; answer = (N-1)!·(D(u)+D(v)-2L(u)); verified on samples 1 and 2.
Write the complete O(N+Q) implementation (fast IO, inverse sieve, prefix arrays D/L, factorial, query loop, joined output).
Edge-case audit: N=2 (fact=1, output A_2), u=1 (D(1)=L(1)=0), A_i reduced mod MOD, results normalized non-negative via `% MOD`, inv array sized N+2 so inv[N+1] is valid.
Logic verification by hand: N=3 query (2,3) gives 3 (matches brute force over both trees), plus samples 1 and 2 confirmed.
